summary: Frontend testing of Community Product Database Phase 1 (Toolbox Vault). Login as mechanicltz@gmail.com (Pro). Verified: (1) AddChooser now shows THREE options with 'Quick Add' first (testID add-choose-quick), followed by Add Item and Add Set/Bundle; (2) tapping Quick Add navigates to /quick-add and renders the QUICK ADD screen with qa-model field; (3) MATCH flow — typing 'ZMODEL999' triggers debounce lookup (branch=one), the Community-match card renders with checkboxes imp-name, imp-brand, imp-category, imp-consumable each showing value+consensus count, and qa-name auto-fills from the catalog; tapping ADD TO MY INVENTORY (qa-save) POSTs /api/tools -> 200 and navigates to /tool/{id}?startEdit=1 with the imported brand/category/name applied on the item edit screen; (4) NO-MATCH flow — 'ZZNOPE12345' shows the 'No community match yet' info box and qa-save still creates the tool and navigates to the edit screen; (5) 'Contribute to Community Catalog' row on More/VAULT > ACCOUNT renders the toggle-community switch, defaults ON, can be toggled OFF/ON, and persists after page reload (state read via GET /community/settings on refresh).
action_items: OBSERVATIONAL (not a bug): For account mechanicltz@gmail.com the ZMODEL999 catalog entry currently resolves to brand 'OtherBrand' / name 'Other Wrench' / category 'Hand Tools', NOT 'TestBrandZ' as stated in the review request. Confirm whether the seeded catalog entry has since been rewritten or whether a different profile is being served by /api/community/lookup. Functionally the branch='one' path works correctly with whatever brand is in the catalog.

OBSERVATIONAL: For the ZMODEL999 entry seen in this run, MSRP and tags values are empty in the catalog, so imp-msrp and imp-tags checkbox rows are not rendered (Check component correctly returns null when value is empty). Not a bug, but if E1 wants those rows always visible for QA verification the review-request seed data should include MSRP and tags on TESTBRANDZ|ZMODEL999.
critical_code_review_comments: quick-add.tsx doSave payload never sends serial_number/serial_numbers; however the backend derives serial_number from model_numbers[0] (visible in the POST /api/tools response where serial_number=ZMODEL999). Not a bug, just a subtle behaviour worth noting if E1 later separates model# and serial#.

AddChooser 'Add Item' & 'Add Set / Bundle' create a placeholder tool via api.createTool as soon as they are tapped (before the user enters anything). Existing behaviour, but on a FREE account with 0 slots left this would burn the last slot silently. Out of scope for this feature but flagging for awareness.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only per request; backend already curl-verified)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test tools on mechanicltz@gmail.com's inventory during MATCH + NO-MATCH save verification (names 'Other Wrench' from import and 'TEST_QA_NoMatch_v1'). Please have E1 or user clean these up if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Native TouchableOpacity on Expo web preview does NOT fire its onPress reliably when Playwright uses page.click(selector, force=True). Use element_handle.click() (no force) with scroll_into_view_if_needed() first. Applies to qa-save and any other TouchableOpacity. Login: mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321! (Pro/lifetime, no tool cap). App shows a 'What's New' (GOT IT) modal on first load post-login — dismiss with page.click('text=GOT IT', force=True).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Initial appearance that qa-save did nothing was a Playwright interaction quirk (force=True click bypassed the TouchableOpacity synthetic event); regular click works and the full end-to-end flow (POST /api/tools -> router.replace to /tool/{id}?startEdit=1) is functional.
